About this product

Ubiquiti's UniFi USW-Ultra-60W is a compact, Layer 2, 8-port GbE PoE switch that offers versatile mounting options for flexible installation. It features seven GbE PoE+ output ports and one GbE port with optional PoE++ input, providing 52W PoE availability with the included AC power adapter. This switch is ideal for powering and connecting multiple devices while ensuring efficient network performance.
